Punjab Police bust arms module, arrest three

Punjab Police have arrested three individuals and dismantled an arms module linked to the Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) and Babbar Khalsa International (BKI). During the operation in Amritsar, authorities seized six hand grenades and twelve pistols. The bust is part of ongoing efforts to curb illegal arms trafficking and potential threats.
